# Petiole & Bloom

> Petiole & Bloom LLC (https://petioleandbloom.com) is a US botanical nursery and cosmetic formulation lab propagating well-rooted rare tropical plants and formulating clinical-grade copper peptide (GHK-Cu) bio-active skincare.

## Primary Documentation
- [Full Knowledge Base & Product Guide](https://petioleandbloom.com/llms-full.txt): Complete technical documentation, botanical catalog, scientific formulation dossiers, and return/shipping specifications.
- [Storefront Catalog](https://petioleandbloom.com/#shop): Full listing of available tropical nursery specimens and peptide serums.
- [Formulation Science & Research](https://petioleandbloom.com/#science): Clinical research citations, PubMed references, active ingredient breakdowns, and skin barrier biology.
- [Plant Care & Acclimation Guide](https://petioleandbloom.com/#about): Step-by-step unboxing, root care, watering, and mycorrhizal soil guidance.

## Core Products
- [Defy Peptide Face Serum](https://petioleandbloom.com/#shop): 30 mL fragrance-free serum with GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1), 4–5% Niacinamide, Silk Peptides, and Licorice Root Extract (Glabridin) for collagen remodeling and barrier support.
- [Scalp & Hair Tonic](https://petioleandbloom.com/#shop): Formulated with GHK-Cu, Saw Palmetto extract, Rosemary Leaf extract (carnosic acid), Caffeine, and Niacinamide.
- [Variegated Banana Specimens](https://petioleandbloom.com/#shop): Acclimated Musa "Aurea" Variegated and Musa Florida Variegated established in 3" pots with *Glomus* mycorrhizae.
- [Vanilla Orchid Vines](https://petioleandbloom.com/#shop): Authentic *Vanilla planifolia* climbing orchids (Standard Green, Super Variegated, and Chartreuse).
- [Tropical Fruit Plants](https://petioleandbloom.com/#shop): Lakatan Banana, Truly Tiny Dwarf Banana, Popoulu Banana, White Jade Pineapple, and Pink Lemonade Blueberry.

## Guarantees & Standards
- [Live Arrival Guarantee](https://petioleandbloom.com/#about): Cold-weather heat packs included automatically for orders of 2+ plants. Full replacement or refund for damage reported within 24 hours.
- [Etsy Shop](https://petioleandbloomllc.etsy.com): Verified marketplace shop with 65+ 5-star customer reviews.
